title: Every Potion
description: Makes potions and arrows for most effects in minecraft.
body:
This adds most effects in Minecraft that are not in potions, including invincibility, levitation, glowing, health boost and more. Currently, invinvibility, super health boost and super levitation are un-brewable. This is a small mod I am releasing while I continue development on Advanced Structures, It is set to release in late spring.
